body: Loved the espresso and the quick service, will be back every week!
Waited 30 minutes for a table on a slow Tuesday and no one apologized.
Great pastries, but the music was a bit too loud for a weekday morning.
Ordered a latte and got a plain coffee instead, and the staff argued with me about it.
The barista remembered my order from last time, small touch that made my day.
Coffee was good but the wifi kept dropping while I was trying to work.
Best oat milk cappuccino in the neighborhood, consistent every single visit.
Table was sticky and stayed that way even after I asked for it to be wiped down.
Friendly staff and cozy seating, just wish they had more vegan pastry options.
